sharedRules.name: Blessings
sharedRules.description:
A unit containing Blessings gains First Strike (Hatred). Model parts with Mount are not affected. 
 The model can cast the following three Bound Spells (3+), with Type: Caster, and Duration: One Turn. ullorUllor’s Blessing The target’s unit gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks). sunnaSunna's Blessing The target’s unit gains Flaming Attacks.
 Each enemy unit in contact with the target’s unit when the spell is cast, suffers D6 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks. volundVolund’s Blessing The target’s unit gains Zeal.

sharedRules.name: Imperial Authority
sharedRules.description:
At the start of each friendly Player Turn, each model with Imperial Authority may select one of the following effects, called Orders, and apply it to a single unit, with Duration: One Turn. The target unit must: 
 • Be a Parent or Support Unit. 
 • Be the model’s own unit, or be within range of the model’s Commanding Presence or Beacon of Courage (if it has one of these rules). 
 • The chosen target cannot already be under the effect of an Order. 
 On The Double!The target gains +1" Cha and +2" Mob. Steady, Men! The target gains Disciplined, and its Courage Tests gain Minimised. Ready! Aim! Fire!The target gains Accurate. Brace For Impact!The target gains Fight in Extra Rank and Shoot in Extra Rank.

sharedRules.name: Parent Unit
sharedRules.description:
A unit containing a model with this rule is referred to as a Parent Unit. 
Parent Unit gains Fight in Extra Rank while there is at least one Support Unit engaged in the same combat.

sharedRules.name: Support Unit
sharedRules.description:
A unit containing a model with this rule is referred to as a Support Unit. 
Support Units within 8" of a Parent Unit gain Resolute.
 During the opponent’s Charge Phase, Support Units may perform one of the following actions: 
 • Supporting Fire: the Support Unit may perform an out of sequence Shooting Attack towards an enemy unit that has successfully performed a Charge Move against a friendly Parent Unit within 8". 
Apply the normal rules for Shooting Attacks, ignoring the Parent Unit for Cover and Line of Sight purposes. 
 • Counter Charge: after enemy units finish their Charge Moves, Support Units within 8" of a successfully charged friendly Parent Unit may choose one enemy unit that has Charged the Parent Unit and declare a Charge, applying the normal rules for Charging (Line of Sight, Front Arc, rolls for Charge Range, etc.).
 A Support Unit that performs a Counter Charge is considered to have at most one Proper Rank for the purpose of inflicting Surrounded, with Duration: Round of Combat.
